what: A wide photo stays sticky throughout the section while a white panel rises over the right half. When the panel’s top edge reaches screen center, the photo slides 40vw left over 1s power1.inOut, placing the subject (a piano) on the left half beside the panel. Scrolling back up rewinds over the same length. For half-photo, half-text sections that page through a product series one by one

options.shift: Distance images travel (vw), default 40 — images are laid out this much wider than the cell and move from +half to −half
options.side: When right, slides to the right (when the panel sits on the left), default left
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.45,0,0.55,1”, default power1.inOut
options.start: ScrollTrigger start relative to the panel, default top center
options.min: Below this width (px) the window does not animate, default 768 — css also fits photos to the cell under 767px
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo slot pinned to the screen (sticky that follows down by one section height)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Plate that rises and pushes the photo. If none, the Section’s own top edge

note: Photo slot placed behind the section with position:absolute; Laid out with inset:0 and pinned with sticky inside it, the board stays stuck for the whole section height (one screen of title + board). With reduced motion, it swaps position the moment the board touches (so the photo isn’t hidden under the board)

from.where: index.html .lp-series (four series): original .js-lineup-primary-img --move-x 20 → -20 (object-position calc(50% + move×1vw), photo center moves 40vw), 1s power1.inOut, trigger .js-lineup-primary-trigger top center, toggleActions play none none reverse, 768px and up only.
